thread:
Aria: Follow-up from the postmortem — multiple repeat incidents where metric misalignment + HPA jitter caused cache evictions and fallback to cold variants. Need a compact runbook update: Quick triage, telemetry commands, precise escalation steps, and who owns verification.

Aria: Suggest we add a 'Telemetry sanity check' block with exact Grafana queries and the Prometheus one-liners we used, plus a single 'run-this-first' script.

Samir: I'll take runbook edits. Plan: add a top-level 'Quick Triage' (5 bullets), a 'Telemetry sancheck' section, and an 'Escalate if' box.

Jules: Add the exact PromQL I used during the incident: 

Jules: ```
# eviction rate per node (10m)
rate(cache_evictions_total{job="kv"}[10m])
# cold-model-hit ratio per route (10m)
(sum(rate(model_cold_loads_total[10m])) by (route) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[10m])) by (route))
```

InfraBot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/metric-misalignment-207001 (sha: aa11bb).

Tanya: We need one-liners for oncall to paste. Example: 

Tanya: ```
# recent eviction rate per node (10m avg)
curl -s "https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total%5B10m%5D)" | jq .
# per-route cold hit ratio (10m)
curl -s "https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query?query=(sum(rate(model_cold_loads_total%5B10m%5D)) by (route) / sum(rate(model_requests_total%5B10m%5D)) by (route))" | jq .
```

Lee: For mitigations, add two reversible steps and an emergency path. I'll draft commands.

Lee: ```
# 1) route to warm variant (quick, reversible)
redwoodctl routes update --route default --model model-stable-warm --force --note "incident fallback"
# 2) increase reserved pool temporarily
redwoodctl capacity set --pool inference-prod --gpus 12 --duration 10m
# rollback: restore route
redwoodctl routes update --route default --model model-stable --note "rollback"
```

Samir: Add explicit thresholds to runbook: if eviction_rate per node > 0.05 * cache_size OR route cold-hit ratio > 0.25 for 10m -> follow the Quick Triage and page eng-sre. Include exact prometheus label names.

Jules: Also include a short 'What to expect' entry: pinning warm variant usually increases p95 by ~30-60ms and costs ~+$2.50/hr per 1000 QPS. Put numbers as estimates.

Tanya: Owners and deadlines: 
- Samir: runbook PR with Telemetry sanity check + Quick Triage — due 36h.
- Jules: add PromQL examples and Grafana panel links — due 48h.
- Lee: mitigation commands + rollback + cost delta note — due 48h.
- Aria: coordinate verification and schedule 1-hr dev smoke test — due 72h.

Aria: I'll create a tracker card and list PR links. Also add a brief phone-tree in runbook header: primary oncall -> eng-sre -> platform lead, with pager tags @eng-sre-oncall and @platform-oncall.

Samir: I'll tag reviewers @Jules @Lee @Aria. Please add inline comments if wording or commands look risky.

Lee: I'll include rollback commands for autoscaler annotations and a note that these actions require eng-sre approval unless incident P0.

Aria: Thanks — once PRs are merged, update the postmortem tracker so we can mark follow-ups resolved. :shipit:
